**Here is a list of HoloWiki resources for learning about DCG.**

This simple guide was written by JohnFP and covers all of the basics of plate preperation:

[http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/A_Beg ... ach_to_DCG](http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/A_Beginners_Approach_to_DCG)

Great tips to keep things simple from Joe Farina:

[http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/A_Simple_DCG_Recipe](http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/A_Simple_DCG_Recipe)

Here is the G307 recipie that makes DCG work faster with the C315 laser (Or any SLM green laser):

[http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/G307_DCG_Formula](http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/G307_DCG_Formula)

Information about green lasers suitable for holography:

[http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/Types ... PSS_Lasers](http://www.holowiki.com/index.php/Types_of_Lasers#DPSS_Lasers)

Information about the classic Argon Ion lasers that drove DCG till 2005:
